title: Eutectic electrolytes: a new platform for high-safety batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3568-3613
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05298F, Review Article
Zheng Liu, Fan Feng, Wanchang Feng, Guanwen Wang, Bin Qi, Min Gong, Fan Zhang, Huan Pang
This review elucidates the components, formation and properties of eutectic electrolytes (EEs) in characterization and simulation, highlighting intrinsic EEs and composite electrolytes for large-scale energy storage.
